subject: Access assertion timeline, SCIM deltas, and role assignment ledger for SIG review
messages:
From: Abby Collins <abby.collins@summithealth.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: security@summithealth.com
Date: Sat, 9 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit ask: SCIM deltas + SAML samples + role timeline

Hi Karthik / Marcus,

As part of our SIG intake review this quarter we need a compact package showing:
- SCIM delta exports covering 2028-08-01 through 2028-09-01 (creation/deprovision events)
- A handful of SAML assertion samples (successful auth + one failed assertion example)
- A timeline/ledger of role assignment changes for the last 90 days for tenant summithealth-prod

Can you confirm whether these can be delivered by EOD USD Tuesday (2028-09-12)? If you have a shared Drive folder or a secure transfer option, please point us there. If there are any redactions required for PII, let us know up front; we can accept role IDs in place of usernames if easier.

Thanks,
Abby Collins
Security Analyst
SummitHealth

--
Attachment: request-specs.pdf (stub)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Abby Collins <abby.collins@summithealth.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 9 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit ask: SCIM deltas + SAML samples + role timeline

Abby — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested artifacts; quick notes on scope and plan: 

1) SCIM deltas: we will export provisioning deltas from our SCIM ingestion pipeline (events + delta flag) covering 2028-08-01 -> 2028-09-01. These will be delivered as a CSV with hashed usernames.

2) SAML assertions: we will include three sampled assertions (one successful login, one failed due to attribute mismatch, one assertion with elevated role mapping). We will redact IP addresses and session cookies.

3) Role assignment ledger: Marcus will produce a ledger (spreadsheet) showing owner, role_id, assignment_time, removal_time, and justification text where present. We will include both admin/service and product roles — let us know if you want to exclude service accounts.

Delivery timeline: we can get a first pass to you by 2028-09-11 EOD PT. If that works, we’ll flag anything that looks like it requires legal review or redaction earlier.

Sharing: we’ll place artifacts in a Drive folder (link below) and set view-only access for your security mailbox. If you need SFTP instead, flag that.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GkXRm-example-folder

--
Note: cc’ing Marcus and Vanessa to own extraction and ledger assembly.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, Abby Collins <abby.collins@summithealth.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Sep 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Audit ask: SCIM deltas + SAML samples + role timeline

Karthik — forwarding the task thread. Delivery note and included artifacts:  

On Tue, 9 Sep 2028 at 10:03, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Abby — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested artifacts; quick notes on scope and plan:...

Attached: scim-delta-202808-202809.csv (trimmed, hashed), saml-assertion-samples.txt (redacted), role-assignment-ledger-2028Q3.xlsx (workbook with comments).

Quick summary of what’s in each:
- scim-delta-202808-202809.csv — columns: event_id, timestamp, change_type (create/update/delete), target_type (user/group/serviceAccount), target_id_hashed, source_system, actor_id_hashed
- saml-assertion-samples.txt — three raw assertion snippets; we removed AssertionConsumerURL and IP addresses and replaced actual email addresses with role IDs
- role-assignment-ledger-2028Q3.xlsx — includes a 'notes' column where ops recorded justification. We added a 'minimal_privilege_flag' where we noticed unusually broad roles.

If SummitHealth prefers role IDs only (no hashed_user column) we can provide that variant; we kept hashed_user for traceability with our incident logs.

Vanessa — can you review the 'minimal_privilege_flag' items and add brief remediation suggested per item? I’ll push the Drive folder link once permissions are set.

Thanks,
Marcus
Staff SRE, Inference Serving
--
Attachment stubs: scim-delta-202808-202809.csv; saml-assertion-samples.txt; role-assignment-ledger-2028Q3.xlsx
From: Abby Collins <abby.collins@summithealth.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: security@summithealth.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 9 Sep 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit ask: SCIM deltas + SAML samples + role timeline

Hi team — received, and appreciate the clear packaging. A couple of quick clarifications before we close this loop: 

- For the role ledger, can you add a column indicating whether the role was created by a human or by an automation (e.g., onboarding API)? That helps with our control design notes.
- For SCIM deltas, can you confirm if deletions include soft-deletes (suspended) vs hard deletes — a separate flag would be ideal.

If you can drop an updated ledger with those two items by Monday morning PST (2028-09-11 11:00 PT), we should be set for the SIG QA pass. Otherwise, your current package looks good and we can mark it as accepted pending the two clarifications.

Cheers,
Abby
Security Analyst, SummitHealth
